title: It's never clear before committing whether resting a hollow via one method (verses only, crown only, or both) is reversible or whether combining methods is strictly better — I only learned 'both together rests him deeper' by asking the Hollow King directly; a player who doesn't ask could commit to a shallower ending without realizing a better one was available.
